text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I swore I was gonna win this time for sure.
I did all the prep, checked my fortune, and everything, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~gh!
What am I supposed to do~~!
choice_data_list: Let's not rush and just keep at it.
Times like this call for fortune-telling!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hawa! Those words!
They sound just like a divine oracle from a fortune slip!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it like that,
maybe you're my fortune slip, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Blessings upon you~! Blessings upon you~~!
Please continue to guide and teach me from now on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so, please accept this thank-you offering!!
It's an amulet to protect you from stubbing your pinky toe~!

...At any rate,
it seemed she had gotten her energy back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah...!! Not only did I lose my head, but I forgot the very essence of fortune-telling, too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my mind's eye has opened!
Bzz-bzz-zap! Let's do a reading right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The angle of these ears signifies "Where there's a will, there's a way"!
Then a way I must make! Through training...!!

Respecting Matikanefukukitaru's motivation,
we got in some extra running.
